narr: An upper level trough moved over a warm, moist airmass and generated thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Four inches of rain fell in two hours in the Austin area. A video on Twitter showed minor flooding on N. Lamar Blvd. between W. 9th St. and W. 10th St. near Shoal Creek in Austin.

Thunderstorms produced four inches of rain in two hours in Austin. This led to flooding closing several streets including potions of Houeke Ln. and Posten Ln. near Austin Bergstrom International Airport.
